guia.what: A multi-line text field. It shares the label, hint, error, and variants with Input, and adds auto-growing height.
whenUse: The expected text spans several lines, like a comment, description, or note.
You want the field to grow with its content (auto-resize).
The user needs to see everything they’ve written at once.
whenAvoid: The text is short and fits on one line → `input`.
It’s a value from a closed set → `select`.
dos: Give it a starting number of rows that matches what you expect.
Build it with the `field` markup and, if there’s a limit, show the counter.
donts: Don’t use it for a single line just because it looks bigger.
Don’t hide the character limit if there is one.

nucleo: It’s a native `<textarea>`, plus its own clear button. The caret starts at the end of the initial value, as in Input. To make the height grow as you type, listen to `input` and copy `scrollHeight` to the height. Without it, the textarea still works, at a fixed height.
